# TextField

A labelled text input or textarea in the contact form's style: uppercase muted label, color-fob-900 field, 2px corners, amber focus.

`FOB.TextField` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<FOB.TextField id="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="FOB.TextField" id="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (TextFieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | Render a textarea. |
| `rows` | `number` | Textarea rows. Default 5. |
| `prefix` | `string` | Fixed leading segment, e.g. "+506". |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'prefix'>._
